scope: Standalone wolf: rounded chest with small tuft, retracted throat, lower withers, corrected lip stroke and revised fitted ink eyes. Existing games, runtime fur/tail/outline systems and viewer ZIP preserved.

sculpt.design: Lower withers, retracted mid-throat, rounded brisket with small terminal tufts; retained tapered face and pointed ears.

revisionsReviewed: Rejected the first large throat cut and low withers render: it pinched the chest and made the neck too thin. Widened the transition to eliminate local deformation folds.
Reduced withers lowering and used a rounded Gaussian throat falloff. Retained the lower brisket volume and added small terminal tufts with dilute tapered ink strokes.
Moved and redrew the ink eyes, added a small dilute pigment highlight; shortened and thinned the lip stroke, joined its front split and relaxed inherited mouth-corner bumps.
Front views exposed red side-projection spill after sculpting. Replaced the first width-based fade with a smooth normal-aware mask, preserving side pigment while clearing the front chest.
Final front/profile/three-quarter and complete side views, open/half/closed eyelids, Walk and seven Run phases inspected before capturing the final actual-model video.

video.source: Actual Chromium/Three.js capture; FFmpeg captions only. No generated or retouched wolf imagery.
shots: 3–6 s: mouth, neck and chest profile

validation: Production Vite build passed; source and built GLB hashes match.
22 clips, 48 corrective shapes, 30 fur controls and both shared outline passes load without page or shader errors.
Three skin bindings normalized, finite and nonnegative.
Native mesh retains closed manifold topology; all 48 Run offsets finite and 35,541 protected lower-limb/tail vertices unchanged.
Passive tail stability, length constraints and transitions passed; all 22 clips finite.
Paint-only bake preserves the existing UVs and normal atlas.
MP4 frame count, duration and complete decode passed.
Existing Sunward/Inkbound game files and permanent viewer ZIP unchanged.
limits: Art revision of the existing standalone wolf. Combat animation clips retained; not redesigned or exhaustively visually reviewed. Visual review does not claim exact reproduction of the supplied illustrations.
